notes.title: [Notice]Game is officially live!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We are glad to announce that Fruit Attacks VR is officially live!

Below are additional features during Early Access. And we feel sorry can't make many improvements. 

- Added Oculus Rift as a supported device. 
- Added ten more languages. 
- Improved some designs and fixed bugs.

Thank you for playing Fruit Attacks VR and if you run into any trouble while playing the game let us know. We will investigate any issues right away.
